bias.zh: 偏空 · 再度跌破 200 日均线

read.en: Arm fell 7.3% on Oct 22 to $210.10, trading between $208.31 and $217.97. It is below the falling 5-day ($222.7), 10-day ($237.3), 30-day ($271.7) and 100-day ($290.1) averages and back under the rising 200-day ($225.6). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 7 and is below zero, histogram little changed; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Sep 28 ($257.19), and RSI is 31.
read.zh: Arm 10月22日下跌 7.3%，收于 $210.10，盘中区间 $208.31–217.97。股价位于下行的 5 日（$222.7）、10 日（$237.3）、30 日（$271.7）和 100 日均线（$290.1）下方，并再度跌破上行的 200 日均线（$225.6）。MACD 自 10月7日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图变化不大；抛物线 SAR 自 9月28日起看空（$257.19），RSI 为 31。

read.en: The drop lost the 200-day and broke the $217.3–219.4 support (Oct 20 low, Aug 3 low), both now resistance. Resistance is $217.3–219.4, then $222.7–225.6 (5 and 200-day) and $238 (Oct 14 close). Support is $208.3 (Oct 22 low), then $200–200.9 (May 12 low). A close above $219.4 would target $225.6; below $200, the next swing low is $160.9 (Oct 22, 2025).

r.en: Aug 3 low $219.4; Oct 20 low $217.3, now resistance
